testcase.name: Scenario: Change a main-panel command button size: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:339:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change a main-panel command button size ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And "Shell" is a standard-sized button in the 3D Model "Modify" main panel ✔ When the user right-clicks "Shell" and opens "Button Size" ✔ Then "Standard" is selected and "Large" is available ✔ When the user selects "Large" ✔ Then "Shell" is displayed with a larger icon and its label below ✔ And the other commands in the panel reflow ✔ When the user right-clicks "Shell" and opens "Button Size" ✔ Then "Large" is selected ✔ When the user selects "Standard" ✔ Then "Shell" returns to a small icon with its label beside it
